summary: Al Rajhi Bank Q3 2026 revenue hit $11.12B, beating $10.77B estimate; EPS of $1.08 missed $1.09 forecast by 0.9%, stock rose 2.78% to $60.90.
Nine-month net income climbed 13.3% YoY to SAR 20.9B; Q3 profit up 12% to SAR 7.1B with net interest margin expanding 42 bps to 3.51%.
Management reaffirmed 2026 guidance: ROE above 23.5%, cost-to-income below 23%, NIM expansion of 30-40 bps, cost of risk at 35-45 bps range.
CFO warned Q4 margin faces pressure from rising funding costs and potential Fed hikes; CASA ratio declined to 61% from 64% amid deposit mix shift.
Impairment charges surged 50% YoY in Q3; bank monitoring Stage 2 migration in SME lending while maintaining disciplined pricing over volume growth.
